title: All 31 Old Maps · Sky Coordinates & Depths Treasure Guide · Tears of the Kingdom Guide
pairs: 王国之泪残旧的地图全收集：全 31 张残旧的地图天空坐标，含天空交互地图、分布地点列表与收集进度追踪，勾选后可导出已收集 Excel 汇总表，助你集齐全部地底宝藏。

Tears of the Kingdom Old Maps complete collection guide: sky coordinates for all 31 Old Maps, with an interactive sky map, a location list, and collection progress tracking; check items off to export a summary Excel table of collected maps and gather every Depths treasure.
全 31 张残旧的地图都在天空层的宝箱里。拿到一张，游戏就会在地底对应位置标出宝藏（套装、武器与面具等），按图索骥即可取回。

All 31 Old Maps are inside chests in the Sky layer. When you pick one up, the game marks the corresponding treasure in the Depths (armor sets, weapons, masks, and more), so you can follow the map to retrieve it.
下面地图只显示“残旧的地图”这一种搜集品（天空层）。点地图标记打开弹窗可直接标记已收集；在列表里勾选也一样，进度会自动同步并保存在你的浏览器里。

The map below shows only one collectible (Sky layer): Old Maps. Click a map marker to open its popup and mark it as collected directly; checking it in the list works the same way, and progress syncs automatically and is saved in your browser.

The interactive map covers the Sky layer; all 31 Old Maps are in the Sky. The original table did not label a treasure name for No. 14, which was identified as Miner's Mask by cross-checking coordinates. Progress is saved only in your current browser's localStorage, so switching devices or clearing the cache means you will need to check items again; the exported Excel file only includes items you have checked.
